title: What changed in prediction markets
insights:
- **Kalshi parlay losses returned:** On Aug. 22, parlay bettors lost $10.0 million on $33.2 million staked, after losing $7.9 million on Aug. 19 and $4.7 million on Aug. 20; parlays made up 51% of Kalshi’s contracts that day.

- **Underdog accelerates:** Underdog Exchange traded 25.8 million contracts on Aug. 22, up 79.56% from its seven-day average and roughly 1.3% of measured venue volume.

- **Novig gains ground:** Novig reached 34.5 million contracts, 61.12% above its weekly average and about 1.8% of measured volume, putting it ahead of Underdog in absolute activity.

- **Crypto.com/Nadex expands:** Crypto.com/Nadex handled 43.3 million contracts, up 38.20% from its seven-day average and roughly 2.2% of measured volume.

evidence.label: Additional context 1
evidence.sql:
WITH kalshi_days AS (
    SELECT date
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-08-22'
      AND NOT COALESCE(is_partial, FALSE)
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 8
),
sports AS (
    SELECT date, contracts_sports, contracts_nonsports, contracts_parlay,
           share_sports, share_nonsports, share_parlay
    FROM daily_sports_vs_nonsports
    WHERE date IN (SELECT date FROM kalshi_days)
),
taker AS (
    SELECT date, contracts_settled, pnl_gross, fees_taker, pnl_net, pct_settled
    FROM taker_pnl_daily
    WHERE date IN (SELECT date FROM kalshi_days)
),
parlays AS (
    SELECT date, realized_net, hold_to_settlement_net, handle_yes,
           hold_gross, fees_total, contracts_settled
    FROM parlay_pnl_unified_daily
    WHERE date IN (SELECT date FROM kalshi_days)
)
SELECT d.date,
       d.fees_total,
       s.contracts_sports AS sports_excluding_parlays,
       s.contracts_nonsports,
       s.contracts_parlay,
       s.share_sports,
       s.share_nonsports,
       s.share_parlay,
       t.contracts_settled AS taker_contracts_settled,
       t.pnl_net AS taker_pnl_net,
       t.fees_taker,
       p.realized_net AS parlay_realized_net,
       p.handle_yes AS parlay_handle_yes,
       p.fees_total AS parlay_fees
FROM daily_overall d
LEFT JOIN sports s USING (date)
LEFT JOIN taker t USING (date)
LEFT JOIN parlays p USING (date)
WHERE d.date IN (SELECT date FROM kalshi_days)
ORDER BY d.date;

evidence.label: Additional context 2
evidence.sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS latest_date
    FROM category_daily
    WHERE date <= DATE '2026-08-22'
),
category_stats AS (
    SELECT
        kalshi_category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN date = latest_date THEN contracts ELSE 0 END) AS latest_contracts,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN date >= latest_date - INTERVAL 7 DAY
             AND date < latest_date
            THEN contracts
        END) AS prior_7_day_average,
        SUM(CASE WHEN date = latest_date THEN fees ELSE 0 END) AS latest_fees,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN date >= latest_date - INTERVAL 7 DAY
             AND date < latest_date
            THEN fees
        END) AS prior_7_day_fee_average
    FROM category_daily
    CROSS JOIN latest
    WHERE date >= latest_date - INTERVAL 7 DAY
      AND date <= latest_date
    GROUP BY kalshi_category
)
SELECT
    kalshi_category,
    latest_contracts,
    prior_7_day_average,
    (latest_contracts / NULLIF(prior_7_day_average, 0) - 1) * 100 AS volume_change_pct,
    latest_fees,
    prior_7_day_fee_average,
    (latest_fees / NULLIF(prior_7_day_fee_average, 0) - 1) * 100 AS fee_change_pct
FROM category_stats
WHERE latest_contracts > 0
ORDER BY latest_contracts DESC
LIMIT 15;

anchor.question: Build the anchor table for today's Predict Charts industry briefing. For each prediction-market venue, use its latest complete reported day and return venue, report date, reported contract volume, the average of its prior seven complete reported days, and percent change versus that average. Use daily_overall for Kalshi and exclude rows where is_partial is true. Use competitor_daily only for platforms other than Kalshi, add ProphetX from prophetx_daily, and add CME from cme_daily. Never use competitor_daily's Kalshi row; it is not the authoritative Kalshi total. In competitor_daily the `complete` column is only populated for Polymarket_US and is NULL for every other platform, where NULL means the row IS complete. Filter it as COALESCE(complete, TRUE) or omit the filter entirely; never write `complete = TRUE`, which silently discards every platform whose flag is NULL. Exclude partial days. CME is the sparse bulletin series; a normal seven-day lookback spanning seven calendar days is regular, not sparse. Resolve the latest complete reported day SEPARATELY FOR EACH VENUE. Do not filter the whole result to one shared calendar date, and do not require a venue to have a row on the newest date any venue reported: a venue whose most recent complete day is a few days old is reporting normally and still belongs in the table, on its own date. Each venue's prior-seven-day baseline is its own prior seven REPORTED days, which for an irregular reporter spans more than seven calendar days. Every one of these ten venues must appear in the result: Kalshi, Polymarket US, ForecastEx, DKeX, Underdog Exchange, Crypto.com/Nadex, ProphetX, Novig, Rothera, CME.
anchor.sql:
WITH all_reports AS (
    SELECT
        'Kalshi' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts_total AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM daily_overall
    WHERE NOT COALESCE(is_partial, FALSE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN platform = 'Polymarket_US' THEN 'Polymarket US'
            ELSE platform
        END AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM competitor_daily
    WHERE platform IN (
        'Polymarket_US',
        'ForecastEx',
        'DKeX',
        'Underdog Exchange',
        'Crypto.com/Nadex',
        'Novig',
        'Rothera'
    )
      AND COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'ProphetX' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        contracts AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM prophetx_daily
    WHERE COALESCE(complete, TRUE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'CME' AS venue,
        date AS report_date,
        cme_total_vol AS reported_contract_volume
    FROM cme_daily
),
ranked_reports AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY venue
            ORDER BY report_date DESC
        ) AS report_rank
    FROM all_reports
),
latest_reports AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        report_date,
        reported_contract_volume
    FROM ranked_reports
    WHERE report_rank = 1
),
prior_seven AS (
    SELECT
        venue,
        AVG(reported_contract_volume) AS prior_seven_day_average
    FROM ranked_reports
    WHERE report_rank BETWEEN 2 AND 8
    GROUP BY venue
)
SELECT
    l.venue,
    l.report_date,
    l.reported_contract_volume,
    p.prior_seven_day_average,
    (l.reported_contract_volume / NULLIF(p.prior_seven_day_average, 0) - 1) * 100
        AS percent_change_vs_average
FROM latest_reports l
LEFT JOIN prior_seven p USING (venue)
WHERE l.venue IN (
    'Kalshi',
    'Polymarket US',
    'ForecastEx',
    'DKeX',
    'Underdog Exchange',
    'Crypto.com/Nadex',
    'ProphetX',
    'Novig',
    'Rothera',
    'CME'
)
ORDER BY CASE l.venue
    WHEN 'Kalshi' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Polymarket US' THEN 2
    WHEN 'ForecastEx' THEN 3
    WHEN 'DKeX' THEN 4
    WHEN 'Underdog Exchange' THEN 5
    WHEN 'Crypto.com/Nadex' THEN 6
    WHEN 'ProphetX' THEN 7
    WHEN 'Novig' THEN 8
    WHEN 'Rothera' THEN 9
    WHEN 'CME' THEN 10
END;
